verdict.rationale:
Ledgy's docs directly describe cap-table core functionality: importing historical transactions/certificates with documents attached, share/option grant issuance in bulk, custom vesting schedules, SAFE/instrument support implied via cap table data model, and a companyCaptable API exposing live cap table data for integrations with auditors/investors. Reporting and compliance features (financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP, audit-ready reports, permissioned access) reinforce the 'single source of truth' claim.

missing for 10: explicit mention of SAFE instrument handling, independent/third-party corroboration (e.g., customer case study or review) that investors/auditors actually rely on the platform as source of truth.
